# GaitRoute

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/walk_routes.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/walk_routes.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

The route the kinematic walker is recording (GaitRoutes), on the rig entity.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `episode` | `int` | routes started so far (default 0) |
| `found` | `bool` | drawn in the slope band (default false) |
| `from` | `glm::vec3` | the route's start point, on the ground (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `direction` | `glm::vec3` | horizontal unit direction of the route (default glm::vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0)) |
| `start_tick` | `uint64_t` | WorldClock tick at which the route started (default 0) |
| `warm_ticks` | `uint64_t` | ticks walked before recording, whole windows (default 0) |

## Notes

Emplaced and written by GaitRoutes only.

## Side effects of those systems
